translations.「……不用讓。我想贏。」: "...No need to give in. I want to win."
translations.「……以為你會答應。下次先問。」: "...Thought you would agree. Ask first next time."
translations.「……只打一個句點，也看得懂？」: "...You can understand it by just typing a period?"
translations.「……知道了。下次到家，我會傳訊息給你。」: "...I understand. I will send you a message next time I get home."
translations.「『大概』通常就是沒有。需要我替你安排作息嗎？」: "'Probably' usually means not. Do you want me to arrange your schedule for you?"
translations.「一本旅行散文。作者寫了很多偏僻的小鎮，讀著會想親自去看看。」: "A book of travel prose. The author writes about many remote towns. When you read it, you will want to visit it yourself."
translations.「一直叫名字，有點遠。」: "Keep calling names, it's a bit far."
translations.「一直躲著也很可惜。冬天有冬天才看得到的風景。」: "It's a shame to keep hiding. There are scenery that can only be seen in winter."
translations.「一封手寫信。字可以不好看，但內容不能敷衍。」: "A handwritten letter. The words may not be beautiful, but the content cannot be perfunctory."
translations.「一起玩的存檔、吃過的東西、你坐過的位置。普通的就好。」: "The save files we played together, the things we ate, the places you sat. Just ordinary ones."
translations.「上次你說會照顧好自己。這幾天有做到嗎？」: "Last time you said you would take care of yourself. Have you done it these days?"
translations.「下週有雙人賽。我報名了。」: "There's a doubles match next week. I signed up."
translations.「也好。名字從你口中說出來，本來就不一樣。」: "That's fine. The name is different when it comes out of your mouth."
translations.「也很實際。只是醒來後別忘了吃東西。」: "It's also very practical. Just don't forget to eat when you wake up."
translations.「也是。你不用替我扛所有決定。」: "That's right. You don't have to make all the decisions for me."
translations.「也許。但多留意一次，可能就少一次遺憾。」: "Maybe. But if you pay more attention, you may have less regrets."
translations.「也許。但我不想等失去後才說早知道。」: "Maybe. But I don't want to wait until I lose it to say I knew it earlier."
translations.「也許吧。但成熟不代表能把所有感情都關掉。」: "Maybe. But maturity doesn't mean you can turn off all your feelings."
translations.「也許吧。那我就在這裡，等你想說的時候。」: "Maybe. Then I'll be here, waiting for you to say something."
translations.「大多數時候喜歡安靜。不過氣氛對了，熱鬧也不壞。」: "I like quiet most of the time. But if the atmosphere is right, being lively is not bad either."
translations.「大型電玩展。有限定試玩。」: "Large-scale video game exhibition. Limited trial available."
translations.「小測驗。草莓塔和巧克力蛋糕，你會留下哪一個？」: "Quiz. Which one would you keep, the strawberry tart or the chocolate cake?"
translations.「不。真錯了就得拉住我，別讓我越走越遠。」: "No. If you're really wrong, you have to hold me back and don't let me go further."
translations.「不太擅長。我習慣先照顧別人，輪到自己就會忘記怎麼開口。」: "I'm not very good at it. I'm used to taking care of others first, and I forget how to speak when it's my turn."
translations.「不用一直說話。坐近一點，做自己的事就好。」: "You don't have to talk all the time. Just sit close and do your own thing."
translations.「不用完全一樣，但得敢指出我錯在哪，也願意在我需要時站過來。」: "It doesn't have to be exactly the same, but you have to be brave enough to point out where I went wrong and be willing to stand up when I need it."
translations.「不用把我當易碎品。但……有人注意，確實不壞。」: "You don't need to treat me as fragile. But...someone pays attention to it, so it's really not bad."
translations.「不怕黑。我怕的是黑暗裡有需要幫忙的人，我卻沒看見。」: "I'm not afraid of the dark. What I'm afraid of is that there are people in need of help in the dark, but I don't see them."
translations.「不知道說什麼。會放水、拿吃的、待在旁邊。」: "I don't know what to say. I can put water, get food, and stay by my side."
translations.「不是。怎麼突然提她？」: "No. Why did you mention her so suddenly?"
translations.「不是血緣才算。會回來、會留位置，就是。」: "It's not about blood. It's about coming back and leaving a place."
translations.「不是盲目保密，而是先為對方著想。這答案很好。」: "It's not about keeping secrets blindly, but thinking about the other person first. That's a good answer."
translations.「不是客人用的。」她停了一下。「是家人。」: "It's not for guests." She paused. "It's family."
translations.「不是看對方說了什麼，而是看他在不方便時還願不願意守約。」: "It's not about what the other person said, but whether he is willing to keep the promise even when it's inconvenient."
translations.「不需要。只是想一起。」: "No need. I just want to be together."
translations.「今天沒有別的安排吧？你打算在這裡留多久？」: "You have no other plans today, right? How long do you plan to stay here?"
translations.「今年有沒有哪個節日，你想和我一起過？」: "Is there any holiday this year that you want to spend with me?"
translations.「公平。我會用行動讓你放心。」: "Fair enough. I will take action to reassure you."
translations.「太好了。原來等待的人，不只我一個。」: "Great. It turns out I'm not the only one waiting."
translations.「手指都白了。別逞強。」: "Your fingers are all white. Don't be brave."
translations.「支持不是什麼都說對。真正的朋友會拉你一把。」: "Support doesn't mean saying everything is right. A true friend will support you."
translations.「比起價錢，我更在意每天看見它們時的心情。」: "Rather than the price, I care more about how I feel when I see them every day."
translations.「以『為你好』為理由，卻不肯讓對方選擇的謊言。」: "A lie that uses 'it's for your own good' as an excuse but refuses to let the other party choose."
translations.「以前有人在我最狼狽時拉過我一把。我只是不想忘記那種感覺。」: "Someone helped me when I was at my worst. I just don't want to forget that feeling."
translations.「出門可能用到。你需要可以拿。」: "You might need it when you go out. You can take it if you need it."
translations.「出門會穿。現在不需要。」: "I'll wear it when I go out. I don't need it now."
translations.「只有這樣？我還以為你會再貪心一點。」: "That's all? I thought you would be a little more greedy."
translations.「只是普通髮夾。瀏海會擋視線，固定住方便。」: "It's just an ordinary hairpin. The bangs will block the view, so it's convenient to fix it."
translations.「只是想對得起自己的眼睛而已。」: "I just want to be worthy of my own eyes."
translations.「可以，但我不放水。先從正確站姿開始。」: "Okay, but I won't let go. Let's start with the correct stance."
translations.「可以。我會挑一首適合你的，不隨便敷衍。」: "Okay. I will choose a song that suits you, and I won't just perfunctory it."
translations.「可以。我會配合你的速度，不拿晨跑標準嚇你。」: "Okay. I will match your speed and won't scare you with morning running standards."
translations.「可以。條件是，你也要讓我照顧你的幸福。」: "Yes. The condition is that you also let me take care of your happiness."
translations.「可以。爆炸很多的那部。」: "Okay. The one with a lot of explosions."
translations.「可以不怕。不能不準備。」: "You don't have to be afraid. You have to be prepared."
translations.「可以問問嗎？你對我的第一印象是什麼？」: "Can I ask? What was your first impression of me?"
translations.「可靠。我最討厭讓人不知道要等多久。」: "Reliable. What I hate most is people not knowing how long they have to wait."
translations.「可靠嗎？這評價不錯。以後有事可以找我。」: "Is it reliable? That's a good review. You can come to me if you need anything in the future."
translations.「外面若下一整天的雨，你通常會怎麼過？」: "If it rains all day outside, how do you usually spend your time?"
translations.「平常叫名字就好。只有兩個人的時候……你可以自己想一個。」: "Usually, just give me a name. When there are only two of you... you can think of one by yourself."
translations.「未來若能選，你想住在熱鬧城市，還是安靜小鎮？」: "If you could choose in the future, would you like to live in a bustling city or a quiet town?"
translations.「正義感又不能讓人免疫嫉妒。我也是普通人。」: "The sense of justice does not make people immune to jealousy. I am also an ordinary person."
translations.「先承認自己怕，再決定要不要往前。假裝不怕只會看不清楚。」: "First admit that you are afraid, and then decide whether to move forward. Pretending that you are not afraid will only make you unable to see clearly."
translations.「先選角色。我不放水。」: "Choose a character first. I won't let you down."
translations.「先離開一下，免得說出傷人的話。等冷靜了再承認自己在意。」: "Leave for a moment to avoid saying hurtful words. Wait until you calm down before admitting that you care."
translations.「合理，但太普通了。再給你一次機會？」: "Reasonable, but too ordinary. Give you another chance?"
translations.「同意。被理解的感覺，比禮物本身更珍貴。」: "I agree. The feeling of being understood is more precious than the gift itself."
translations.「回答得很漂亮。明知道可能是哄我，我還是高興。」: "That's a beautiful answer. Even though I know you might be trying to coax me, I'm still happy."
translations.「因為我一直在看你。這個理由夠清楚嗎？」: "Because I've been looking at you. Is this reason clear enough?"
translations.「因為情緒不會自己修正錯誤。」: "Because emotions don't correct their mistakes on their own."
translations.「因為感情不是打贏就有答案。越重要，越怕一開口就失去。」: "Because relationships don't have answers if you win. The more important it is, the more afraid you are of losing it as soon as you open your mouth."
translations.「因為慌張通常解決不了問題。只是……我也不是每次都做得到。」: "Because panic usually doesn't solve the problem. It's just... I can't do it every time."
translations.「她不是獎品。我想要的是她自由地做選擇。」: "She's not a prize. What I want is for her to be free to make choices."
translations.「她不會在意價錢。我要的是她真的會喜歡。」: "She doesn't care about the price. What I want is that she really likes it."
translations.「她在我最莽撞的時候替我收過很多爛攤子，也教我不是每場仗都要硬碰。」: "She helped me clean up a lot of messes when I was at my most reckless, and taught me that not every battle has to be head-on."
translations.「好，我不追問。不過你的表情可沒有這麼說。」: "Okay, I won't ask further. But your expression doesn't say that."
translations.「好，我等你確認。重要的邀請，本來就值得慎重。」: "Okay, I'll wait for your confirmation. An important invitation deserves caution."
translations.「好！先說，我走得快。跟不上就喊我。」: "Okay! First, I walk fast. If you can't keep up, just call me."
translations.「好。不能來就看錄影。」: "Okay. If you can't come, just watch the video."
translations.「好。先保住自己，再找方法接應我。這才叫合作。」: "Okay. Protect yourself first, and then find a way to support me. This is called cooperation."
translations.「好。先學不會焦的蛋。」: "Okay. Let's learn how to make eggs that won't burn first."
translations.「好。你看左邊，我看右邊。」: "Okay. You look at the left and I look at the right."
translations.「好。你要多久可以先說，我會等。」: "Okay. You can tell me how long you want. I will wait."
translations.「好。我也答應不拿『為你好』壓你。」: "Okay. I also promise not to use 'for your own good' to pressure you."
translations.「好。我不追問，只陪著你。需要時再握住我的手。」: "Okay. I won't ask any questions, I'll just stay with you. Hold my hand when you need it."
translations.「好。我先聽完。然後一起處理。」: "Okay. I'll listen to it first. Then we'll deal with it together."
translations.「好。我會珍惜這幾句，不浪費你的時間。」: "Okay. I will cherish these few words and not waste your time."
translations.「好。那你口頭告訴我重點。」: "Okay. Then tell me the key points verbally."
translations.「好。那你的抱怨我也包了，公平吧？」: "Okay. Then I'll take care of your complaints, is that fair?"
translations.「好。那你選，我去換。」: "Okay. Then you choose, I'll change it."
translations.「好。知道自己的極限也是能力。」: "Okay. Knowing your own limits is also an ability."
translations.「好。現在我還說不出口，但至少知道能告訴誰了。」: "Okay. I can't say it yet, but at least I know who I can tell it to."
translations.「好。等你想到時再告訴我，我不急。」: "Okay. Let me know when you think of it. I'm not in a hurry."
translations.「好。數錯要重來。」: "Okay. If you make a mistake in counting, you have to start over."
translations.「好答案。輸了別躲，我請你喝東西。」: "Good answer. If you lose, don't hide. I'll buy you a drink."
translations.「好意不能取消傷害。先道歉，再談理由。」: "Good intentions cannot undo the harm. Apologize first, then discuss the reasons."
translations.「如果一句道歉來得太晚，你還會接受嗎？」: "If an apology comes too late, will you still accept it?"
translations.「如果人人都這麼想，受欺負的人要等誰？」: "If everyone thinks this way, who will the bullied people have to wait for?"
translations.「如果不考慮價格，你覺得什麼禮物最讓人高興？」: "If price is not considered, what gift do you think makes you the most happy?"
translations.「如果只能替我們留下今天的一個畫面，你會選哪個？」: "If you could only leave us one scene from today, which one would you choose?"
translations.「如果只能選一個季節，你會選哪一個？」: "If you could only choose one season, which one would you choose?"
translations.「如果在陌生地方迷路，你會問人還是自己找？」: "If you were lost in a strange place, would you ask someone or look for it yourself?"
translations.「如果有一天我做了很糟的事，你還會站在我這邊嗎？」: "If one day I do something terrible, will you still stand by me?"
translations.「如果有人把秘密交給你，你守得住嗎？」: "If someone entrusts you with a secret, can you keep it?"
translations.「如果你要去很遠的地方，會先告訴我嗎？」: "If you were going somewhere far away, would you tell me first?"
translations.「如果你替人出頭，最後發現自己判斷錯了，怎麼辦？」: "What would you do if you stood up for someone and found out that you were wrong?"
translations.「如果努力很久仍然失敗，你會怎麼辦？」: "What will you do if you try hard for a long time and still fail?"
translations.「如果我告訴你一件連本人都不知道的心事，你守得住嗎？」: "If I tell you something that I don't even know is on my mind, can you keep it?"
translations.「如果我把最脆弱的一面交給你，你會怎麼做？」: "What would you do if I gave you my most vulnerable side?"
translations.「如果我們真的吵架了，你會先來找我嗎？」: "If we really had a fight, would you come to me first?"
translations.「如果我說你有件事做得不對，你會聽嗎？」: "If I told you that you did something wrong, would you listen?"
translations.「如果沒有你，我剛才就不會害羞了。」: "If it weren't for you, I wouldn't be shy just now."
translations.「如果朋友瞞著你做危險的事，你會生氣嗎？」: "Would you be angry if your friend did something dangerous without telling you?"
translations.「如果重要的人選了別人……是不是該笑著祝福？」: "If the important person chooses someone else... shouldn't he smile and bless him?"
translations.「如果真是這樣，那我做的事就有意義。」: "If that's the case, then what I do makes sense."
translations.「如果情況很危險，我叫你先走，你會信我嗎？」: "If the situation is very dangerous and I tell you to go first, will you believe me?"
translations.「忙完一天、房間忽然安靜下來的時候。那時最容易想起你。」: "After a busy day, when the room suddenly becomes quiet. That's when it's easiest to think of you."
translations.「成交。可別小看我拉人的力氣。」: "Deal. Don't underestimate my ability to win people over."
translations.「成交。我回頭，你就在那裡。」: "Deal. When I turn around, there you are."
translations.「有。」她回答得很快，又補了一句：「不討厭。」: "Yes." She answered quickly and added: "I don't hate it."
translations.「有。尤其當我發現，再努力也不能讓所有人滿意時。」: "Yes. Especially when I find that no matter how hard I try, I can't satisfy everyone."
translations.「有。以前太急著證明自己是對的，沒聽完一個人的話。」: "Yes. I used to be so anxious to prove that I was right that I never listened to what a person had to say."
translations.「有一點。所以冬天的披肩和熱茶都不能少。」: "A little. So winter shawls and hot tea are indispensable."
translations.「有人在背後亂說你的事，你會怎麼處理？」: "How would you deal with someone talking nonsense about you behind your back?"
translations.「有你們在，我比以前安心。至於有些事……還在學著接受。」: "With you here, I feel more at ease than before. As for some things... I'm still learning to accept them."
translations.「有些回憶不華麗，只是一群人都還在、燈也還亮著。」: "Some memories are not gorgeous, but the group of people are still there and the lights are still on."
translations.「有明確目標、能靠操作解決問題的。太多文字我會沒耐心。」: "Those who have clear goals and can solve problems through operations. Too many words will make me impatient."
translations.「有的很遠，有的……只能留在回憶裡。」: "Some are far away, and some...can only remain in memories."
translations.「有差。別人的時間也是時間。」: "There is a difference. Other people's time is also time."
translations.「有時沉默很瀟灑，有時也會讓距離越來越遠。」: "Sometimes silence is cool, and sometimes it makes the distance grow farther and farther."
translations.「有時要離開，但至少先弄清楚發生了什麼。」: "You have to leave sometimes, but at least figure out what's going on first."
translations.「有時候。房間太安靜，連主機風扇都很大聲。」: "Sometimes. The room is too quiet, even the console fan is very loud."
translations.「有時確實必要。但說謊的人，也要承擔被怨恨的可能。」: "Sometimes it is indeed necessary. But those who lie also bear the possibility of being resented."
translations.「有想說的時候會說。」: "I will say it when I have something to say."
translations.「老實說，你第一次見我時，是不是覺得我很兇？」: "Honestly, when you first met me, did you think I was fierce?"
translations.「至少你現在敢直說。放心，我不會隨便兇你。」: "At least you dare to speak out now. Don't worry, I won't hurt you casually."
translations.「至少別讓線露出來。安全比省這點錢重要。」: "At least don't let the thread be exposed. Safety is more important than saving this little money."
translations.「至少沒有說謊。今晚早點休息，就算補考通過。」: "At least I didn't lie. If you go to bed early tonight, you will pass the make-up exam."
translations.「行，至少及格。下次加顆蛋會更好。」: "Okay, at least it passed. It will be better to add an egg next time."
translations.「行。我不替你走，但會跟你一起走。」: "Okay. I won't go for you, but I will go with you."
translations.「你上次受傷還想藏起來。要我列清單嗎？」: "You were injured last time and you wanted to hide it. Do you want me to make a list?"
translations.「你已經是了。只是我不常把這種話說出口。」: "You already are. It's just that I don't say it often."
translations.「你不說，下個人可能也只能忍。至少該提醒一次。」: "If you don't tell me, the next person may have to endure it. You should at least remind me once."
translations.「你今天一直看我。怎麼了？」: "You've been looking at me today. What's wrong?"
translations.「你今天反應很慢。沒睡好？」: "You reacted very slowly today. Didn't you sleep well?"
translations.「你今天笑得有點勉強。發生什麼事了？」: "Your smile was a bit forced today. What happened?"
translations.「你手上的擦傷怎麼來的？別說『不小心』就想混過去。」: "Where did you get the scratch on your hand? Don't just say 'accidentally' and just try to get away with it."
translations.「你比我勇敢。那我可以再靠近一點嗎？」: "You are braver than me. Can I get closer?"
translations.「你吃早餐了嗎？別跟我說只喝了咖啡。」: "Did you have breakfast? Don't tell me you only drank coffee."
translations.「你有錯的地方要道歉。其他的，我陪你處理。」: "You have to apologize if you made any mistakes. I'll handle the rest with you."
translations.「你找我是信任，不是麻煩。記住了。」: "You come to me out of trust, not trouble. Remember."
translations.「你每次說『沒問題』時，問題都特別大。」: "Every time you say 'no problem', the problem is really big."
translations.「你和我一樣不懂得放過自己。這可不是稱讚。」: "You don't know how to let yourself go as much as I do. This is not a compliment."
translations.「你的耳機線快斷了。你打算撐到它徹底報廢？」: "Your headphone cord is about to break. Do you plan to hold on until it is completely useless?"
translations.「你的筆記，可以借我看嗎？昨天的招式記錄。」: "Can you lend me your notes? Yesterday's record of moves."
translations.「你很敏銳。那就記得別故意惹我，好嗎？」: "You're very perceptive. Just remember not to mess with me on purpose, okay?"
translations.「你很寬容。只是別讓人把你的寬容當成理所當然。」: "You are very tolerant. Just don't let people take your tolerance for granted."
translations.「你思考時會摸杯緣，緊張時說話會變快，逞強時反而笑得特別明顯。」: "You touch the rim of the glass when you're thinking, you speak faster when you're nervous, and you smile more obviously when you're brave."
translations.「你是早起的人嗎？還是會和鬧鐘談判很久？」: "Are you a morning person? Or do you negotiate with the alarm clock for a long time?"
translations.「你真的願意聽？那我以後可能不會那麼客氣。」: "Are you really willing to listen? Then I might not be so polite in the future."
translations.「你猜，我在房間裡最喜歡待在哪裡？」: "Guess where is my favorite place in the room?"
translations.「你第一次看見我，覺得我很難相處？」: "When you first saw me, did you think I was difficult to get along with?"
translations.「你第一次等我打完比賽，沒有催。回頭時還在。」: "You waited for me to finish the game for the first time and didn't rush you. You were still there when I turned around."
translations.「你最近是不是把太多事往自己身上攬？」: "Have you been taking too many things on yourself lately?"
translations.「你最近常來找我。是因為茶，還是因為別的？」: "You come to me a lot lately. Is it because of tea or something else?"
translations.「你遇到搬不動的東西，會直接找人幫忙嗎？」: "When you encounter something you can't move, do you directly ask for help?"
translations.「你還沒吃。」她掀開保鮮盒。「留了。」: "You haven't eaten yet." She opened the food container. "Keep it."
translations.「坐著等。我去拿點東西，你不准再空腹亂跑。」: "Sit and wait. I'm going to get something, and you're not allowed to run around on an empty stomach again."
translations.「完全相反。沒關係，你還有補考的機會。」: "Completely the opposite. It doesn't matter, you still have a chance to make up the exam."
translations.「我一直覺得，真正的夥伴不用天天說謝謝。但今天想說。」: "I've always felt that a true partner doesn't need to say thank you every day. But I want to say thank you today."
translations.「我也是。不是每個人都要理解，但重要的人不能放著不管。」: "Me too. Not everyone has to understand, but important people can't be left alone."
translations.「我也是。比起輸贏，我更怕我們什麼都不說。」: "Me too. I'm more afraid of us not saying anything than winning or losing."
translations.「我也是。那就別退，我們慢慢往前走。」: "Me too. Then don't retreat, let's move forward slowly."
translations.「我也這麼想。道歉不是結束，是改變的開始。」: "I think so too. An apology is not the end, it is the beginning of change."
translations.「我也這麼想。懂得享受普通，不是件容易的事。」: "I think so too. It's not easy to know how to enjoy the ordinary."
translations.「我不愛吵架，但遇到不講理的事，很難裝沒看見。」: "I don't like to quarrel, but when something is unreasonable, it's hard to pretend not to see it."
translations.「我不會。硬說會很假。」: "I won't. It would be false to insist."
translations.「我正在改。但有些習慣不是說停就停。」: "I'm changing. But some habits just don't stop."
translations.「我在意身邊的人，有什麼奇怪的？」: "I care about the people around me. Is it any wonder?"
translations.「我有件事想請你幫忙。下次我想逃避時，直接叫住我。」: "I have something to ask you for help. Next time I want to escape, just call me."
translations.「我居然輸給甜點了。這筆帳先記著。」: "I actually lost to dessert. Let's keep this account in mind first."
translations.「我知道，所以不是天天吃。你怎麼跟Asteria一樣念我。」: "I know, so I don't eat it every day. Why do you miss me like Asteria?"
translations.「我知道。十二點前睡。」: "I know. Go to bed before twelve o'clock."
translations.「我知道。只是知道和做得到，中間還隔著很遠。」: "I know. It's just that there's a long way between knowing and being able to do it."
translations.「我知道。可她不是一道只看結果的題目。」: "I know. But it's not a question that only depends on the result."
translations.「我知道。所以才更想珍惜還能並肩的時候。」: "I know. That's why I want to cherish the time when we can still be together."
translations.「我知道。直率不等於只准自己說話。」: "I know. Being straightforward doesn't mean you are allowed to speak only for yourself."
translations.「我要練同一招一百次。會很無聊。」: "I'm going to practice the same move a hundred times. It's going to be boring."
translations.「我們比以前親近很多。你有沒有……稍微害怕過？」: "We are much closer than before. Have you ever been...a little scared?"
translations.「我們哪天真的吵起來，你會不會躲著不見我？」: "If we really quarrel one day, will you avoid me?"
translations.「我記得你不喜歡太甜。你還記得我的偏好嗎？」: "I remember you didn't like it too sweet. Do you remember my preference?"
translations.「我會用。但不喜歡一直躲。」: "I can use it. But I don't like hiding all the time."
translations.「我會先把該做的事收好，再允許自己停下來。壞習慣，對吧？」: "I put what I have to do first before I allow myself to stop. Bad habit, right?"
translations.「我會好好收著。也許還會偷偷讀很多次。」: "I will keep it well. Maybe I will read it secretly many times."
translations.「我會查清楚。站你這邊，不等於不問原因。」: "I will find out. Being on your side does not mean not asking why."
translations.「我會記住。到時候，可別嫌我打擾你。」: "I will remember it. When the time comes, don't think I'm disturbing you."
translations.「我會尊重你。但我仍會在門外留一盞燈。」: "I'll respect you. But I'll still leave a light outside the door."
translations.「我會試，但有些感情不是關掉腦袋就會消失。」: "I'll try, but some feelings won't disappear just by turning off your head."
translations.「我會試。至少對你，我可以少逞強一點。」: "I will try. At least I can be less assertive towards you."
translations.「我需要。只是以前不太會承認。」: "I need it. I just didn't know how to admit it before."
translations.「我練了很久。對我不是『只是』。」: "I've been practicing for a long time. It's not 'just' to me."
translations.「我難得認真一次！算了，反正你聽懂就好。」: "It's rare for me to be serious for once! Forget it, as long as you understand."
translations.「我聽說了。你先說你的版本。」: "I heard about it. Tell me your version first."
translations.「把我想得太完美，將來可是會失望的。」: "If you think of me too perfectly, you will be disappointed in the future."
translations.「每天都剛好路過？你的路線很有趣呢。」: "Do you happen to pass by it every day? Your route is very interesting."
translations.「每個人都需要。只是有人不習慣被看見。」: "Everyone needs it. Some people just aren't used to being seen."
translations.「沒必要的話，不想說。」: "I don't want to say it if it's not necessary."
translations.「沒有。就算你有時讓人操心，也從沒讓我後悔。」: "No. Even if you make people worry sometimes, you never make me regret it."
translations.「沒有人一定贏。別把我放得太高。」: "No one is guaranteed to win. Don't put me too high."
translations.「沒怎麼。只是……算了。你玩得開心就好。」: "Nothing. Just... never mind. Just have fun."
translations.「沒錯。只罵人，下一次他還是會瞞著。」: "That's right. If you just curse someone, he will hide it next time."
translations.「沒錯。別亂翻，也別讓東西繼續躺在路上。」: "That's right. Don't rummage around and don't let things continue to lie on the road."
translations.「沒關係。故事不一定只能從書裡聽見。」: "It doesn't matter. Stories don't have to be heard only in books."
translations.「身體累和心裡累不一樣。前者睡一覺通常會好。」: "There is a difference between physical tiredness and mental tiredness. The former is usually better after a good night's sleep."
translations.「那也很好。音樂本來就不必向別人證明品味。」: "That's fine too. Music doesn't have to prove taste to others."
translations.「那天我會空下來。不是為生日，是為了你。」: "I'll be free that day. Not for my birthday, but for you."
translations.「那叫擴大迷路範圍。至少先確認方向。」: "That's called expanding the lost range. At least confirm the direction first."
translations.「那可能僵很久。我不喜歡把友情拿來比輸贏。」: "That might last for a long time. I don't like to compare friendship with winning or losing."
translations.「那可麻煩了。看來重要的日子不能只靠鬧鐘。」: "That's troublesome. It seems you can't just rely on the alarm clock on important days."
translations.「那我也會珍惜你的。這是雙向的約定。」: "Then I will cherish you too. This is a two-way agreement."
translations.「那我今晚就開始排行程。你沒有反悔的機會了。」: "Then I'll start scheduling tonight. You won't have a chance to regret it."
translations.「那我們算是同時開始的。這個答案，我很喜歡。」: "Then we started at the same time. I like this answer very much."
translations.「那我們應該能好好相處，不必一直找話填滿空氣。」: "Then we should be able to get along well without having to fill the air with words all the time."
translations.「那我得小心，別讓你找到離開的理由。」: "Then I have to be careful not to let you find a reason to leave."
translations.「那我就放心往前衝了。你可別半路消失。」: "Then I can go forward with peace of mind. Don't disappear halfway."
translations.「那我會好好看著你，免得這張畫面模糊了。」: "Then I will watch you carefully to prevent the picture from being blurred."
translations.「那我會收下。被人記住這種小事，感覺很好。」: "Then I'll accept it. It feels good to be remembered for such a small thing."
translations.「那我暫時不會把有趣的秘密交給你。」: "Then I won't trust you with interesting secrets just yet."
translations.「那改傍晚。藉口少一個，怎樣？」: "Then change it to the evening. How about one less excuse?"
translations.「那是因為我也練過怎麼不被害怕推著跑。」: "That's because I've also practiced how not to be pushed away by fear."
translations.「那是最後手段，而且通常不是好手段。」: "That's a last resort, and it's usually not a good one."
translations.「那個位置比較靠近插座。猜拳。」: "That location is closer to the socket. Guessing."
translations.「那座白色海邊小鎮，你還記得嗎？如果現在邀請你，你會去嗎？」: "Do you remember that white seaside town? If I invited you now, would you go?"
translations.「那就先休息。明天再決定，不要在最氣的時候放棄。」: "Then rest first. We'll decide tomorrow. Don't give up when you're the most angry."
translations.「那就先聽一半吧——我希望你一直留在我身邊。」: "Then just listen to half of it - I want you to stay with me."
translations.「那就在這裡休息一下吧。至少現在，不必逞強。」: "Then let's take a rest here. At least for now, there's no need to show off."
translations.「那就行。這份友情，我打算留很久。」: "That's fine. I plan to keep this friendship for a long time."
translations.「那就把這杯茶算進去吧。至少別讓今天空著。」: "Then let's count this cup of tea. At least don't leave today empty."
translations.「那就說定了。不是我保護你，是我們並肩。」: "Then it's settled. I'm not protecting you, we're standing side by side."
translations.「那就讓經驗幫它校準。錯過幾次，不代表永遠不準。」: "Then let experience help you calibrate it. Just because you miss it a few times doesn't mean it will never be accurate."
translations.「那種要猜心思的？現實已經夠難了吧。」: "The kind that requires you to guess your thoughts? Reality is hard enough."
translations.「那麼，今天的茶杯就拜託你收了。先從這裡開始。」: "Then, I'll ask you to accept today's tea cup. Let's start from here."
translations.「那樣贏了也不痛快。我可不會放。」: "It wouldn't be fun to win like that. I won't let you go."
translations.「來做個約定。誰先陷進麻煩，另一個就負責把人拉出來。」: "Let's make a deal. Whoever gets into trouble first, the other one will be responsible for pulling them out."
translations.「兩個都答對。看來我確實有被你放在心上。」: "Both answers are correct. It seems that you do take me to heart."
translations.「呵呵，若你負責收拾，我不反對。」: "Haha, if you are responsible for cleaning up, I have no objection."
translations.「所以才要動。體力不是坐著等來的。」: "That's why you have to move. Strength doesn't come from sitting around and waiting."
translations.「承認撐不住不是軟弱。把責任推給別人才是。」: "Admitting that you can't hold on is not weakness. Putting the responsibility on others is."
translations.「放冰箱。餓了要吃。」: "Put it in the refrigerator. Eat when you're hungry."
translations.「明天決賽。你會來嗎？」: "The finals are tomorrow. Will you come?"
translations.「明早要不要一起跑？不用快，先跑完就好。」: "Do you want to run together tomorrow morning? No need to hurry, just finish the run first."
translations.「朋友被誤會時，你會替他說話嗎？」: "When a friend is misunderstood, will you speak up for him?"
translations.「狗。坦率、忠誠，開心時尾巴根本藏不住。」: "Dog. Frank, loyal, and can't hide its tail when it's happy."
translations.「盲目袒護只會害他錯得更遠。」: "Blind protection will only make him make further mistakes."
translations.「知道。但不想改。」: "I know. But I don't want to change it."
translations.「知道。你可以來敲門，但先讓我深呼吸三次。」: "I know. You can knock on the door, but first let me take three deep breaths."
translations.「知道啦。幫人和照顧自己，不該只能選一個。」: "I know. Helping people and taking care of yourself should not be the only choice."
translations.「很公平。只是感情有時不能只等公平。」: "It's fair. It's just that sometimes feelings can't just wait for fairness."
translations.「很好！我會帶水。遲到一分鐘加一圈。」: "Very good! I'll bring water. If you're late for a minute, you'll get an additional lap."
translations.「很好。允許自己難過，和放棄是兩回事。」: "Very well. Allowing yourself to be sad is two different things than giving up."
translations.「很好。至少你有正確的求生本能。」: "Good. At least you have the right survival instincts."
translations.「很好。求助不丟臉，原地逞強才浪費時間。」: "Very good. There's no shame in asking for help. It's a waste of time to act stubbornly."
translations.「很好。真遇到時，我們一起處理。」: "Very good. If we encounter it, we will deal with it together."
translations.「很好的平衡。計畫讓人安心，空白才裝得下驚喜。」: "A good balance. Plans make people feel at ease, and blank spaces allow for surprises."
translations.「很有冒險精神。希望你至少記得帶錢包。」: "Very adventurous. I hope you at least remember to bring your wallet."
translations.「很會回答呢。那我是不是該先替你留一個位置？」: "You're very good at answering questions. Then should I save a place for you first?"
translations.「很準。既然知道了，還敢坐這麼近？」: "Very accurate. Now that you know it, how dare you sit so close?"
translations.「很誠實。不過那樣挑禮物的人，壓力可不小。」: "It's very honest. But it's a lot of pressure for people to choose gifts like that."
translations.「恃強凌弱，還有明明能做點什麼卻拿冷漠當聰明。」: "Bullying, and mistaking indifference for intelligence when you can do something."
translations.「昨天那件事，你為什麼沒找我？」: "Why didn't you come to me about what happened yesterday?"
translations.「是方便。但有些話，值得慢一點寫。」: "It's convenient. But some words are worth writing more slowly."
translations.「是白桃烏龍。香氣很柔，不會太甜。你想試試嗎？」: "It's white peach oolong. The aroma is very soft and not too sweet. Do you want to try it?"
translations.「是在稱讚燈，還是在稱讚我呢？」: "Are you praising the lamp, or are you praising me?"
translations.「是好事。可一個人扛下所有事，不等於獨立。」: "It's a good thing. But taking care of everything by yourself doesn't mean you're independent."
translations.「是啊。幸好有人讓我覺得，那份勇氣值得。」: "Yes. Fortunately, someone made me feel that the courage was worth it."
translations.「是啊。某人卻還躲在玩笑後面。」: "Yeah. But someone is still hiding behind the joke."
translations.「洗髮精沒了。一起去？」: "The shampoo is gone. Let's go together?"
translations.「相信，但不盲從。直覺會提醒我，理性則負責確認。」: "Believe it, but don't follow it blindly. Intuition will remind me, and reason will confirm it."
translations.「看起來不像，並不代表不會。人都差不多。」: "Just because it doesn't look like it doesn't mean it won't happen. Everyone is the same."
translations.「看過三次。會記得。」: "I've seen it three times. I'll remember it."
translations.「約好十點，你通常幾點到？」: "We have an appointment at ten o'clock. What time do you usually arrive?"
translations.「若有人誤解你，你會立刻解釋嗎？」: "If someone misunderstands you, will you explain it immediately?"
translations.「若你哪天難過到不想說話，希望我怎麼陪你？」: "If you are so sad one day that you don't want to talk, how do you want me to accompany you?"
translations.「若我說是，你打算怎麼負責？」: "If I say yes, how are you going to take responsibility?"
translations.「若是你提醒，我或許真的會聽一次。」: "If you remind me, I might actually listen once."
translations.「要是能說放就放，我早就不用煩了。」: "If I could just let it go, I wouldn't have to worry about it long ago."
translations.「剛才那個人對你說什麼？」: "What did that person say to you just now?"
translations.「害怕某天重要的人離開，而我連挽留都說不出口。」: "I'm afraid that one day the important person will leave, and I won't even be able to say anything to keep him."
translations.「旅行時，你喜歡事先排好行程，還是到了再說？」: "When traveling, do you prefer to plan your itinerary in advance or wait until you arrive?"
translations.「氣象說兩小時。你會餓。」: "The weather says two hours. You'll be hungry."
translations.「海邊那座白色小鎮。你若有興趣，我可以把那一頁借你看。」: "That white town by the sea. If you are interested, I can lend you that page to read."
translations.「真公平。只是這樣一來，我就猜不到你的喜好了。」: "That's fair. But this way, I won't be able to guess your preferences."
translations.「真可惜。那份回憶只好由我一個人保管了。」: "What a shame. I have to keep those memories alone."
translations.「真的？把地址給我。好吃的話我欠你一份。」: "Really? Give me your address. If it's delicious, I owe you a share."
translations.「真狡猾。把我的真心問出來，自己卻想逃。」: "How cunning. You ask me my true feelings, but you want to escape."
translations.「能做想做的事，重要的人都還在。不必每天精彩，平安就好。」: "You can do what you want to do, and the important people are still here. It doesn't have to be exciting every day, just be safe."
translations.「能處理和不能找我，是兩回事。我是你朋友。」: "Being able to handle it and not being able to come to me are two different things. I'm your friend."
translations.「能讓重要的人安心生活的日常。聽起來很普通，但最難守住。」: "A daily routine that allows important people to live with peace of mind. It sounds ordinary, but it is the hardest to keep."
translations.「記錄、重看、重來。難過可以，不能只難過。」: "Record, re-watch, start over. It's OK to be sad, but you can't just be sad."
translations.「做便當。外出時比較方便。」: "Make a bento. It's more convenient when you go out."
translations.「偶爾可以。但躺到腰痛就別怪我沒提醒。」: "Occasionally, you can. But if your back hurts when you lie down, don't blame me for not reminding you."
translations.「偶爾安靜很好。但別把自己藏到沒人找得到。」: "It's nice to be quiet sometimes. But don't hide yourself until no one can find you."
translations.「偶爾依賴喜歡的人，應該不算太過分吧？」: "It shouldn't be too much to rely on the person you like occasionally, right?"
translations.「問你。如果有人插隊，你會直接出聲嗎？」: "Ask you. If someone cuts in line, will you speak out directly?"
translations.「問個直接的。你現在把我當朋友嗎？」: "Let me ask you directly. Do you consider me a friend now?"
translations.「晚上。安靜，連線也穩。」: "Night. It's quiet and the connection is stable."
translations.「晨跑、整理裝備，回來時順手幫鄰居搬了箱子。普通的一天。」: "Going for a morning run, organizing my equipment, and helping my neighbor move boxes when I came back. Just an ordinary day."
translations.「清單我寫好了。你負責推車。」: "I've written the list. You are responsible for pushing the cart."
translations.「現在才發現？那我以後稍微收斂一點。」: "You just discovered it now? Then I'll be a little more restrained in the future."
translations.「現在別問。等我有勇氣，我會自己說。」: "Don't ask now. I will tell myself when I have the courage."
translations.「現在嗎？」她看向你。「比以前更接近了。」: "Now?" She looks at you. "Closer than before."
translations.「現在還不能告訴你。你可以繼續猜。」: "I can't tell you yet. You can keep guessing."
translations.「現在藏已經太晚了。過來，我先看看。」: "It's too late to hide now. Come here, let me take a look first."
translations.「第一次聊天就這麼會說話？我得小心一點了。」: "You're so talkative in our first chat? I have to be more careful."
translations.「第一次嗎？你站在門口，明明緊張，還是很認真地向我打招呼。」: "Is this your first time? You stood at the door, obviously nervous, but you still greeted me seriously."
translations.「習慣。遇到狀況時，我不想被衣服礙手礙腳。」: "Get used to it. When I encounter a situation, I don't want my clothes to get in the way."
translations.「貪心不是壞事，但得先想好吃不完怎麼辦。」: "Greedy is not a bad thing, but you have to think about what to do if you can't finish it."
translations.「這才是我要的答案。不是袒護，是一起負責。」: "This is the answer I want. It's not about protecting, it's about taking responsibility together."
translations.「這才像夥伴。來，把最麻煩的先交給我看。」: "This is like a partner. Come on, give me the most troublesome part first."
translations.「這才對。小問題拖久了，常常會變大問題。」: "That's right. Small problems often turn into big problems if they are left for too long."
translations.「這包很辣。你吃嗎？」: "This bag is very spicy. Do you want to eat it?"
translations.「這句話我知道，卻一直學不會。你得多提醒我幾次。」: "I know this sentence, but I have never been able to learn it. You have to remind me a few times."
translations.「這份信任我收下了，也會小心不讓你後悔。」: "I accept this trust, and I will be careful not to make you regret it."
translations.「這些不容易。以前沒有。」: "These are not easy. It hasn't happened before."
translations.「這是你說的。我若真的半夜敲門，不許後悔。」: "This is what you said. If I really knock on the door in the middle of the night, I won't regret it."
translations.「這首曲子不錯。」她把一邊耳機遞給你。: "This is a good piece of music." She handed you an earphone.
translations.「這個邀請我接受。店由我選，時間由你決定。」: "I accept this invitation. I choose the store, and you decide the time."
translations.「這問題沒有排名。信任的方式不一樣，不能拿來比。」: "There is no ranking for this question. The methods of trust are different and cannot be compared."
translations.「這部分先保密。秘密太快說完，就不有趣了。」: "This part will be kept secret for now. If the secret is revealed too quickly, it won't be interesting."
translations.「這就是我想聽的。不是佔有，是珍惜。」: "That's what I want to hear. It's not about possessing, it's about cherishing."
translations.「這答案很安全。可我偶爾也想被你特別選中。」: "This answer is very safe. But sometimes I want to be specially chosen by you."
translations.「這裡安全。也沒有外人。」: "It's safe here. There are no outsiders."
translations.「速度快、近身強的。不能逃。」: "Fast and strong at close quarters. Can't escape."
translations.「連段、防守、起身壓制。先從連段。」: "Combo, defend, get up and suppress. Start with combo first."
translations.「都可以最難選。」: "Both can be the hardest to choose."
translations.「都說不能排名了。你怎麼突然像小孩子？」: "They said you can't be ranked anymore. Why do you suddenly act like a child?"
translations.「陪我訓練、在我衝過頭時拉住我，還有……偶爾聽我抱怨。」: "Train with me, catch me when I get too carried away, and... occasionally listen to my complaints."
translations.「最近有沒有一件事，你希望有人陪你完成？」: "Is there anything you wish someone could do with you recently?"
translations.「喂，重點不是金額。那是別人的東西。」: "Hey, it's not the amount that matters. That's someone else's thing."
translations.「喂！至少還是有程度差別吧。」: "Hey! At least there is a degree of difference."
translations.「喔。」她把螢幕往你這邊轉了一點。: "Oh." She turned the screen a little towards you.
translations.「喜歡安靜。不代表一直想一個人。」: "I like silence. It doesn't mean I want to be alone all the time."
translations.「喜歡聲音。不喜歡鞋子濕。」: "I like the sound. I don't like my shoes getting wet."
translations.「就是因為說出口會改變關係，我才需要時間。」: "Just because speaking out will change the relationship, I need time."
translations.「普通才難得。失去過安穩的人最清楚。」: "It's rare to be ordinary. People who have lost their stability know it best."
translations.「曾經有。不是變成對方喜歡的樣子，而是學會說出原本藏著的話。」: "It has happened before. It's not about becoming what the other person likes, but learning to say what was originally hidden."
translations.「測試不是保證贏。」: "Testing is not a guarantee of winning."
translations.「無聊與否，通常取決於身邊的人和自己的心情。」: "Whether you're bored or not usually depends on the people around you and your mood."
translations.「等我們再熟一點，我會考慮。期待太久可別怪我。」: "I'll consider it when we get to know each other better. Don't blame me for waiting too long."
translations.「等等，你是在說我像狗嗎？……忠誠那段可以留著。」: "Wait, are you saying I'm like a dog?...You can keep the loyalty part."
translations.「答對了。午後的光最好，你觀察得真仔細。」: "That's right. The light in the afternoon is the best. You observed it very carefully."
translations.「答對了。觀察得很仔細，值得一小塊獎勵。」: "Correct answer. Observed carefully, deserves a small reward."
translations.「結果一樣。你留下了。」: "The result is the same. You stay."
translations.「跑步。跑到腦子只剩呼吸和腳步，很多事就能重新想清楚。」: "Running. When all you can think about is breathing and footsteps, you can think clearly about many things."
translations.「跑步和拳擊。前者能整理思緒，後者能讓思緒直接安靜。」: "Running and boxing. The former can organize your thoughts, and the latter can directly quiet your thoughts."
translations.「隊友斷線。還有……來不及。」: "My teammates are disconnected. And...it's too late."
translations.「嗯。不是不准你找別人。要告訴我。」: "Yeah. It's not that you are not allowed to find someone else. You have to tell me."
translations.「嗯。不能修就收好。」: "Yeah. If you can't fix it, just put it away."
translations.「嗯。可是進步後，我還是要贏。」: "Yes. But after improving, I still want to win."
translations.「嗯。正面打比較快。」: "Yeah. It's faster to hit him head-on."
translations.「嗯。有想回來的地方，也有人會等。」: "Yeah. If you want to come back to a place, there are people who will wait for you."
translations.「嗯。死黨的好處，就是可以走得很久。」: "Yeah. The advantage of being a best friend is that we can go a long way."
translations.「嗯。我知道。」她把椅子往你靠近。: "Yeah. I know." She moved the chair closer to you.
translations.「嗯。那不用勉強。」: "Yeah. There's no need to force it."
translations.「嗯。所以要帶傘。」: "Yeah. So I need to bring an umbrella."
translations.「嗯。重要到有些話……說出來反而會改變一切。」: "Yeah. It's so important that some words...saying them will change everything."
translations.「嗯。真正的溫柔，不該奪走別人的決定。」: "Yes. True gentleness should not take away other people's decisions."
translations.「嗯。硬碟要買大一點。」: "Yeah. I need to buy a bigger hard drive."
translations.「想逃和真的逃不一樣。別把我想成不會累。」: "There's a difference between wanting to escape and actually escaping. Don't think that I won't get tired."
translations.「想過。比我願意承認的次數更多。」: "Thinked about it. More times than I'd like to admit."
translations.「感動是感動，但兩個人一起倒下有什麼用？」: "I am moved, but what's the use of two people falling together?"
translations.「搭檔要一起扛事，要求當然不能太低。」: "If partners have to work together, the requirements must not be too low."
translations.「新角色還沒練好。陪我測？」: "The new character hasn't been trained yet. Will you test it with me?"
translations.「會。只是我不喜歡用嫉妒束縛別人。」: "Yes. It's just that I don't like to restrain others with jealousy."
translations.「會。但不是氣對手。氣自己沒看懂。」: "Yes. But don't be angry with your opponent. Be angry with yourself for not understanding."
translations.「會。但你也要自己跑。不要站著等我救。」: "Yes. But you have to run by yourself. Don't stand and wait for me to save you."
translations.「會。你答應陪我，卻臨時去找別人的時候。」: "Yes. When you promised to accompany me, but went to find someone else temporarily."
translations.「會一些。比起複雜的料理，我更擅長讓普通的東西變得好吃。」: "I know a little bit. I'm better at making ordinary things taste better than complicated dishes."
translations.「會忘。所以我想留下。」: "I will forget. So I want to stay."
translations.「會很難受。可能不想說話。但隔天還是會練。」: "It will be very uncomfortable. You may not want to talk. But you will still practice the next day."
translations.「會啊，只是不代表我會穿著它追人三條街。」: "Yes, but that doesn't mean I will chase people down three streets wearing it."
translations.「會啊。房間越安靜，有些聲音反而越清楚。」: "Yes. The quieter the room, the clearer some sounds will be."
translations.「會累，但休息一下就好了。事情總得有人做。」: "It will be tiring, but it will be fine if you take a rest. Someone has to do the work."
translations.「會累死。挑值得解釋的人，其他的用行動證明。」: "It will be exhausting. Pick those who are worthy of explanation and prove the others with actions."
translations.「會麻煩。但也會接住你。」: "It will be troublesome. But I will catch you."
translations.「會煮麵。蛋不會破。」: "I can cook noodles. I can't break eggs."
translations.「當然可以。只是下次記得早點說，我不會勉強你。」: "Of course. Just remember to say it earlier next time, I won't force you."
translations.「當然有。第一次的濃湯，連我自己都救不回來。」: "Of course. I couldn't even save myself from the soup for the first time."
translations.「當然最好。但有準備，不等於期待壞事發生。」: "Of course it's best. But being prepared doesn't mean expecting bad things to happen."
translations.「當然會。只是生氣不代表一定要提高音量。」: "Of course. Just because you're angry doesn't mean you have to raise your voice."
translations.「腰只有一個。逞強受傷可不帥。」: "You only have one waist. It's not cool to get hurt if you show off your strength."
translations.「話會更直，動作也會更重。通常Asteria一眼就看得出來。」: "The words will be straighter and the movements will be heavier. Usually Asteria can tell at a glance."
translations.「話會變少，笑容也會更客氣。很可怕嗎？」: "You will talk less and smile more politely. Is it scary?"
translations.「誠實很好。至於改進，可以先從少按一次開始。」: "Honesty is good. As for improvement, start by pressing it once less."
translations.「跟朋友比賽，你希望對方放水嗎？」: "When you compete with your friends, do you want them to let you down?"
translations.「路上撿到錢包，你第一步會做什麼？」: "If you pick up a wallet on the street, what is your first step?"
translations.「遇到了總不能不管吧。你別把這說得多偉大。」: "You can't ignore it when you encounter it. Don't say how great this is."
translations.「對，先從她真正需要的開始。你比我冷靜。」: "Yes, let's start with what she really needs. You are calmer than me."
translations.「對。正義感不是免錯金牌，錯了就負責。」: "Yes. A sense of justice is not a gold medal for making mistakes. If you make a mistake, you will be held responsible."
translations.「對。先講道理，講不通再想別的辦法。」: "Yes. Speak the truth first. If it doesn't make sense, then think of other ways."
translations.「對。別把力氣浪費在每張嘴上。」: "Yes. Don't waste your energy on every mouth."
translations.「對。我可以尊重她，也可以允許自己痛。謝謝你。」: "Yes. I can respect her, and I can also allow myself to feel pain. Thank you."
translations.「對。站朋友這邊，不代表可以不分是非。」: "Yes. Standing on the side of your friends doesn't mean you can ignore right and wrong."
translations.「對我來說很重要。因為那個人真的受傷了。」: "It's important to me. Because that person was really hurt."
translations.「慢慢喝，小心燙。看你的表情，應該合口味吧？」: "Drink slowly, be careful not to burn it. Judging from your expression, it should suit your taste, right?"
translations.「算。知道你在，就算。」: "Forget it. Even if I know you're here, forget it."
translations.「認識很久了，當然知道一些。就這樣。」: "We've known each other for a long time, so of course I know something. That's it."
translations.「辣的、熱的，吃完會出汗的那種。拉麵也行。」: "Spicy, hot, the kind that will make you sweat after eating it. Ramen is also fine."
translations.「確實麻煩。但沒有它，再近的距離也只是表面。」: "It is indeed troublesome. But without it, no matter how close the distance is, it will only be superficial."
translations.「確認所有人都平安，門也鎖好，才會真的鬆下來。」: "Only after you make sure everyone is safe and the door is locked will you really relax."
translations.「整理房間、讀書，偶爾去找新的甜點店。很普通吧？」: "Tidying up the room, reading, and occasionally finding new dessert shops. Pretty ordinary, right?"
translations.「螢幕反光。窗簾要關嗎？」: "The screen is reflective. Do you want to close the curtains?"
translations.「貓也行。只是牠不理我時，我不知道哪裡做錯了。」: "The cat is fine too. But when it ignores me, I don't know what I did wrong."
translations.「輸了也不算。狀態不公平。」: "It doesn't matter if you lose. The situation is unfair."
translations.「輸了才會知道哪裡要練。」: "Only when you lose will you know where to practice."
translations.「鋼琴和弦樂居多。需要集中時，我偏好沒有歌詞的曲子。」: "Mostly piano and string music. When I need to concentrate, I prefer music without lyrics."
translations.「謝了。你不用替我決定，只要別讓我一個人就好。」: "Thanks. You don't have to decide for me, just don't leave me alone."
translations.「謝了。你不逼我回答，反而讓我更想告訴你。」: "Thank you. You don't force me to answer, but it makes me want to tell you even more."
translations.「謝啦。好看不是重點，但被稱讚還是挺高興的。」: "Thank you. Looking good is not the main point, but it's nice to be praised."
translations.「謝謝。不過我原本期待的是更仔細的答案。」: "Thank you. But I was expecting a more detailed answer."
translations.「謝謝。有時候不追問，反而是最溫柔的回答。」: "Thank you. Sometimes not asking questions is the most gentle answer."
translations.「謝謝。但也別把我關進保護裡，我仍想自己走路。」: "Thank you. But don't put me under protection. I still want to walk on my own."
translations.「謝謝。你沒有追問是誰送的，這點也很體貼。」: "Thank you. You didn't ask who sent it, which is very considerate."
translations.「謝謝。窗邊那盞燈是我親自挑的，晚上看書時很舒服。」: "Thank you. I chose the lamp by the window myself. It's very comfortable when I read at night."
translations.「謝謝你沒逼我成為別人，也沒在我狼狽時走開。你是我最重要的死黨。」: "Thank you for not forcing me to be someone else and not walking away when I was embarrassed. You are my most important best friend."
translations.「謝謝你願意告訴我。我不急著給答案，先陪你整理。」: "Thank you for telling me. I'm not in a hurry to give you the answer. I'll sort it out with you first."
translations.「還在學。但至少我不想再犯同樣的錯。」: "Still learning. But at least I don't want to make the same mistake again."
translations.「舊手把。還有你們給我的東西。」: "Old handles. And what you gave me."
translations.「關機就聯絡不到。先充。」: "If you turn off the phone, you can't be contacted. Charge it first."
translations.「難得放假，你選爬山還是窩在家？」: "It's a rare holiday. Would you rather go hiking or stay at home?"
translations.「騙過別人容易，騙自己很累。我希望你不用那樣。」: "It's easy to deceive others, but it's very tiring to deceive yourself. I hope you don't have to do that."
translations.「贏代表方法有效。輸代表還能改。」: "Winning means the method is effective. Losing means it can be changed."
translations.「聽起來不錯。下次帶來，我們比誰先破關。」: "Sounds good. Bring it next time and we'll see who can beat it first."
translations.「聽起來不錯。窗邊的位置可以分你一半。」: "Sounds good. I can give you half of the seat by the window."
translations.「Asteria 今天邀你喝茶了？」她很快補了一句，「只是問問。」: "Asteria invited you for tea today?" She quickly added, "Just asking."
translations.「Asteria 的禮物，我拿不定主意。你能陪我去挑嗎？」: "Asteria's gift, I can't make up my mind. Can you accompany me to pick it out?"
translations.「Nyx 最近常找你呢。你們似乎相處得很好？」: "Nyx has been looking for you a lot lately. You two seem to get along well?"

translations.一場突來的風雨打亂了原本的行程，你和Nyx一起幫忙疏散人群、搬開障礙。: A sudden storm disrupted the original schedule. You and Nyx helped evacuate the crowd and remove obstacles.

translations.向她借充電線。: Ask to borrow her charging cable.
translations.向重要的人說明，其他人不勉強。: Make it clear to the people who matter and don’t force it on others.
translations.回程她說：「下次得早點出門。不是為了吃，是因為跟你一起繞路也挺有意思。」: On the way back, she said, "I have to go out early next time. Not for food, but because it's fun to take a detour with you."
translations.回程時她把選擇交還給你。你牽起她的手，帶她走上一條沒有安排過的路。她笑得比整天任: On the way back she hands the choice back to you. You take her hand and lead her on an unplanned path. She smiled more genuinely than she had ever smiled all day.

translations.她小聲說出一個簡短暱稱。「……可以嗎？」: She whispered a short nickname. "...Is that okay?"
translations.她仍微笑著。「這個願望，我不建議你實現。」: She was still smiling. "I don't recommend you to fulfill this wish."
translations.她立刻打開重播。「看第三回合。」: She immediately turned on the replay. "Look at the third round."
translations.她立刻遞過來。「下次早點充。」: She handed it over immediately. "Charge earlier next time."
translations.她向你伸出拳頭：「戀愛那些我可能永遠搞不明白。但你是我選的搭檔，這件事不會變。」: She extended her fist to you: "I may never understand the love thing. But you are my chosen partner, and this will never change."
translations.她回握住你。「嗯。現在這樣，就足夠了。」: She holds you back. "Yeah. This is enough for now."
translations.她在你旁邊坐下，把音量調低。「要說嗎？」: She sat down next to you and turned the volume down. "Do you want to say it?"
translations.她安靜了一瞬。「你這句話，比安慰更讓人安心。」: She was quiet for a moment. "Your words are more reassuring than comforting."
translations.她耳尖泛紅，視線仍盯著螢幕。「……看比賽。」: The tips of her ears turned red and her eyes were still fixed on the screen. "...Watch the game."

translations.說Nyx是可靠的朋友，但自己現在想陪她。: Say that Nyx is a reliable friend, but he wants to stay with her now.
translations.需要幫忙會開口嗎: Will you ask for help if you need help?
translations.敷衍說大概有。: It's a perfunctory thing to say, probably.
translations.確定要清除目前進度嗎？: Are you sure you want to erase your current progress?
translations.練習結束後，Nyx 沒像平常一樣立刻離開。她坐在場邊，問你是否有過明知不該、卻無: After practice, Nyx didn't leave immediately like usual. She sits on the sidelines and asks you if you've ever had feelings that you knew you shouldn't have but couldn't stop.
translations.請她下次推薦一首。: Ask her to recommend a song for next time.
translations.請她教自己基礎動作。: Ask her to teach you basic moves.
translations.請她說一句真心話: Ask her to tell the truth
translations.選冬天，因為適合一起喝熱茶。: Choose winter because it is suitable for drinking hot tea together.
translations.選生日，想替她好好慶祝。: I chose her birthday because I wanted to celebrate it for her.
translations.選她手上的同款茶。: Choose the same tea she has.
translations.選她看起來更喜歡的草莓塔。: Choose the strawberry tart she seems to like better.
translations.選她現在看著自己的樣子。: Choose the way she looks at you now.
translations.選爬山，順便邀她同行。: Choose mountain climbing and invite her to go with you.
translations.選桌上的甜點。: Choose the dessert on the table.
translations.選動作片，問她是否一起看。: Choose an action movie and ask her if you want to watch it together.
translations.選整天躺著。: Choose to lie down all day.
translations.選離所有人都很遠的地方。: Choose a place far away from everyone.
translations.點擊角色卡片切換房間，點擊角色或選項開始對話。: Select a character card to visit their room, then click the character or choose a response to talk.
translations.離開前，她替你整理被風吹亂的衣領。「今天很愉快。下次，不用等我邀請。」: Before leaving, she tidied your collar that was messed up by the wind. "I had a great time today. Next time, don't wait for my invitation."
translations.離開時她把戰績小票折好收進口袋。「第一次一起打。要留著。」: When she left, she folded the winning ticket and put it in her pocket. "This is the first time we fight together. Keep it."
translations.勸她乾脆放下。: Advise her to just let it go.
translations.勸她偶爾先休息也沒關係。: It's okay to advise her to take a break once in a while.
translations.邊聽邊問很多問題。: Listen and ask lots of questions.
translations.競爭時會不會放水: Will you give in when competing?
translations.覺得清者自清。: He who feels pure will become pure himself.
translations.攤位快收攤時，她把最後一份熱食塞進你手裡，自己只喝了水。你分她一半，她愣了愣，痛: When the stall was about to close, she put the last piece of hot food into your hand and drank only water. You gave her half, she was stunned and laughed happily.
translations.Asteria 把書闔上。「你今天看起來有些疲倦。工作很多嗎？」: Asteria closed the book. "You look a little tired today. Have you had a lot of work?"
translations.Asteria 承認自己害怕失去，也害怕開口挽留會顯得脆弱。你告訴她，想留下不是: Asteria admitted that she was afraid of losing, and that she was afraid of appearing vulnerable if she opened her mouth to try to stay. You tell her that you want to stay not because you were asked to stay, but because you chose her.
translations.Asteria 看著你驚訝的表情，愉快地承認：「偶爾讓我使點壞心眼，不行嗎？」: Asteria looked at your surprised expression and admitted happily: "Can't you let me be a little mean sometimes?"
translations.Asteria 約你到窗邊的小茶館。她沒有替你點餐，只把菜單推過來，認真聽你挑選: Asteria invites you to the small teahouse by the window. She didn't order for you, she just pushed the menu over and listened carefully to your selection.
translations.Asteria 眨了眨眼。「這次換我不知道該怎麼接了。」: Asteria blinked. "I don't know how to handle it this time."
translations.Asteria 靠近一些。「有句話我練習了很多次，可每次看見你就說不完整。」: Asteria moves closer. "I have practiced a sentence many times, but every time I see you I can't say it completely."
translations.Lumi 把一把備用鑰匙放到你掌心。「拿著。」: Lumi places a spare key in the palm of your hand. "Take it."
translations.Lumi 把另一支手把推過來。「玩嗎？」: Lumi pushed the other hand over. "Want to play?"
translations.Lumi 看了你一眼。「手很冷？」: Lumi glanced at you. "Are your hands cold?"
translations.Lumi 看了看你和她之間的空位。「那邊看得到嗎？」: Lumi looked at the space between you and her. "Can you see it over there?"
translations.Lumi 約你回到房間，桌上放著她第一次學做的便當。煎蛋有一點焦，但每樣都是你喜: Lumi invites you back to the room, where the bento she first learned to make is on the table. The fried eggs are a little burnt, but everything tastes like you like.
translations.Lumi 帶你去她熟悉的遊戲中心，替你選了一台按鍵狀況最好的機台。: Lumi takes you to a game center she is familiar with and chooses a machine with the best buttons for you.
translations.Lumi 默默把水放到你旁邊。「慢點。」: Lumi silently placed the water next to you. "Slow down."
translations.Lumi 難得沒有穿斗篷，只穿著輕便的白色衣裝。她說是因為今天不需要警戒。: Lumi is rarely seen without a cape, wearing only light white clothing. She said it was because there was no need to be vigilant today.
translations.Nyx 低著頭很久，最後長長吐出一口氣：「謝了。至少在你面前，我不用假裝這件事不: Nyx lowered his head for a long time, and finally exhaled a long breath: "Thank you. At least in front of you, I don't have to pretend that this matter doesn't exist."
translations.Nyx 咧嘴一笑。「好。那你的背後也交給我。」: Nyx grinned. "Okay. Then leave your back to me."
translations.Nyx 握緊手指。「想。也怕。她若知道，可能連現在都保不住。」: Nyx clenched her fingers. "I want to. I'm also afraid. If she knew, she might not be able to survive even now."
translations.Nyx 說要帶你去吃真正好吃的街頭料理，結果一路上停下來幫了三次忙。: Nyx said he was going to take you to eat some really good street food, and ended up stopping three times to help out along the way.
translations.Nyx 邀你陪她走一段平常巡視的路。她一路記住壞掉的路燈，也確認獨居老人家的門窗: Nyx invites you to accompany her on some of her usual rounds. Along the way, she memorized the broken street lights and also identified the doors and windows of the old man's house who lived alone.
